decision_rule: Execute phases in priority order. Parallelize only independent tasks with resolved interfaces and ownership. Never auto-merge or weaken gates.

priorities.P0: Blocking safety, ownership, standards and evidence foundations.
priorities.P1: Canonical kernel, VM, blockchain and reproducible toolchain.
priorities.P2: Language, OS, node and end-to-end integration.
priorities.P3: Aurora AI and Genesis Engine behind approved boundaries.
priorities.P4: Hardening, audit closure, release readiness and rollback.

global_gates: Resolve SSOT conflicts or track them as blocking RESIDUALs.
IMPLEMENTED requires code connected to the intended runtime path.
VERIFIED requires exact-SHA test/gate evidence with Run -> Job -> Step -> exit/log/artifact.
No duplicate production VM, algorithm or kernel in specification/governance repositories.
No automatic merge and no gate weakening.
Preserve failed runs; fix, rerun and keep the evidence history.

phases.name: Foundation and safety gates
phases.entry_gate: Canonical ownership is recorded; critical safety requirements and evidence plan are identified.
phases.exit_gate: Ownership decisions, safety plan and evidence infrastructure are versioned; security-critical blockers are closed or remain hard blockers.

work_items.title: Resolve canonical repository and SSOT ownership conflicts before moving or duplicating code.
Establish exact-SHA evidence registry, reproducible toolchain and required CI gates.
Close ShivaCore TCB blockers: VMM mutation/rollback, object/mapping lifetime, ABI and boot/security evidence.
Freeze ATC-Standards contracts for encoding, cryptography, transactions, bytecode and host ABI.
work_items.notes: Do not infer a standard from code alone.

work_items.title: Enforce capability and service boundaries for IPC, networking, Aurora tools and privileged operations.

phases.name: Canonical runtime foundations
phases.entry_gate: P0 exit gate has exact-SHA evidence or explicitly approved non-security residuals.
phases.exit_gate: Kernel, VM, blockchain and toolchain have exact-SHA test evidence; consensus status is explicit.

work_items.title: Verify ShivaCore capability, memory, IPC, scheduler, syscall/ABI and fault-handling invariants.
Implement and verify canonical ATC-VM bytecode, verifier, deterministic engine, gas/resource limits and rollback.
Verify A-TownChain transaction validation, state transition, persistence/recovery and node integration.
Resolve consensus status with explicit threat model, safety/liveness analysis and conformance vectors.
work_items.notes: PoH/PoW/PoS/PoI candidates are not presumed finalized.

work_items.title: Establish reproducible ATC-Toolchain builds, test vectors, provenance and SBOM.

phases.name: Language, OS and end-to-end integration
phases.entry_gate: P1 exit gate has evidence or approved scoped residuals.
phases.exit_gate: Language, OS and node integration tests pass against pinned interfaces.

work_items.title: Connect ATC-Lang grammar/parser/semantic analysis/codegen to canonical ATC-VM and vectors.
work_items.notes: ATC-Lang does not create a second VM.

work_items.title: Integrate canonical ShivaCore into GlobusOS boot and service lifecycle; keep network and AI in service space.
Verify A-TownChain P2P, sync, RPC, operations, upgrades and recovery.
Run cross-repository ABI/protocol compatibility and end-to-end tests from language/compiler through VM and node.

phases.name: AI and product-facing capabilities
phases.entry_gate: P2 integration contracts and cross-system tests pass.
phases.exit_gate: AI and game product paths pass subsystem tests without bypassing security boundaries.

work_items.title: Verify Aurora model/data lineage, evaluation, inference limits, policy/capability mediation, tool sandbox and rollback.
work_items.notes: Aurora is not TCB, consensus authority or canonical VM.

work_items.title: Complete Genesis Engine editor/project, scene/asset/render/runtime/build pipelines and testable APIs.
work_items.notes: Product work can be parallelized if dependencies are independent.

work_items.title: Enable optional AI/chain integration only through explicit least-privilege service APIs after core gates pass.
work_items.notes: Optional feature; must not bypass boundaries.

phases.name: Hardening and release
phases.exit_gate: Release bundle contains provenance, SBOM, test/security results, residuals and rollback instructions.

work_items.title: Complete adversarial fuzzing, property/differential tests, security review and recovery exercises.
Close documentation/source/test traceability residuals and produce release evidence bundles.
Mark release-ready only when exact-SHA required gates, artifacts and rollback evidence pass.

scheduling_policy.concurrency: Parallelize only where dependency graph and SSOT ownership prove independence.
scheduling_policy.calendar_estimates: Do not estimate dates until baseline and measured throughput exist.
stop_conditions: missing exact-SHA evidence for VERIFIED claim

current_baseline.caveat: This roadmap defines order and priorities; it is not evidence that implementation is complete.
